metadata.provenance_note: Calibrated spatial hazard scenarios covering key geographic subregions of Thrissur.

scenarios.name: Puzhakkal Lowland River Overflow
scenarios.affected_region_description: Puzhakkal, Ayyanthole north, Kole agricultural periphery
scenarios.primary_threat: River overtopping and standing flood water on Guruvayur road corridor

scenarios.name: Southern Kole Wetland Embankment Inundation
scenarios.affected_region_description: Arimpur, Manalur, southern Kole agricultural basin
scenarios.primary_threat: Deep inundation (>2.5m) cutting off southwestern escape routes

scenarios.name: Central Thrissur Urban Core Drainage Surcharge
scenarios.affected_region_description: Swaraj Round, Kuruppam Road, High Road commercial district
scenarios.primary_threat: Surface flash flooding and traffic gridlock; impassable for low-clearance vehicles

scenarios.name: Kuriachira - Ollur Low-Lying Corridor Waterlogging
scenarios.affected_region_description: Kuriachira, Nehru Park south, Ollur railway crossing dip
scenarios.primary_threat: Railway underpass flooding and arterial road constriction
